subject: SLA credit request and escrow release — May 28 partial outage
messages:
From: Jason Lee <jason.lee@auracorp.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, billing@auracorp.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SLA credit and escrow release for May 28 partial outage

Hi Markus / Laura,

We identified a spike and partial degradation in inference throughput on May 28, 2027 between 22:05–01:05 UTC (approx 180 minutes total). Our engineering team observed elevated 5xx rates and request timeouts that materially impacted the production workload. Per our contract (SLA section 4.2), we are opening a formal credit request and asking Redwood to: (1) confirm the eligible downtime window, (2) provide the credit calculation, and (3) release any reserved escrow funds toward the credit.

Can you confirm next steps and an estimated timeline for issuance? We need a posted credit before our June 10 invoice run if possible.

Attachments: sample request (we will share logs if helpful).

Thanks,
Jason Lee
Director, Platform Engineering — Auracorp

To: Jason Lee <jason.lee@auracorp.com>

Subject: Re: Request: SLA credit and escrow release for May 28 partial outage

Jason — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the disruption. We're reviewing the incident and will run a formal SLA calculation.

Action plan:
- I'll loop in SRE (Karthik) to produce the downtime window and the calculation (we'll attach the workbook).
- Finance (Laura) will confirm whether we should pull from the existing escrow bucket or issue a credit memo.
- We'll aim to share a proposed credit amount and timing by EOD Wednesday (June 2).

Can you confirm the timezone you gave (22:05–01:05 UTC)? Also, please paste any customer-facing incident notes you already have so we can align messaging.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Jason Lee <jason.lee@auracorp.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SLA credit and escrow release for May 28 partial outage

Markus / Jason — attached are the raw window and the calculation workbook (downtime-window.csv, cred_calc.xlsx). Summary below:  

1) Observed impact window (UTC): 2027-05-28 22:05 -> 2027-05-29 01:05 (180 minutes). We derived this from API gateway error rates and backend KV-cache miss spikes. Full logs are available if you want packet-level traces.

2) Month baseline (May 2027): 31 days = 44,640 minutes.

3) Uptime calculation:
- Total downtime minutes = 180
- Uptime fraction = (44,640 - 180) / 44,640 = 0.995963 (99.5963%)

4) SLA/credit policy (contract, section 4.2):
- SLA target: 99.95% uptime (monthly).
- Per contract table: if actual uptime < 99.95% and >= 99.90% => 10% credit of monthly invoice; if < 99.90% and >= 99.80% => 20% credit; below that escalates.

5) Using that rule: actual uptime 99.5963% falls in the <99.90% bracket (it's 99.5963), which maps to a 20% credit.

6) Auracorp's monthly invoice (most recent) = $120,000 (Apr/May run-rate). Proposed credit (20%) = $24,000. This is the recommended amount per contract terms. The workbook includes an alternate proportional calculation (straight proportional uptime gap) for comparison (gives ~$4,244). We follow the contractual tier table (20%).

Let me know if you want a second pass on the window (we used gateway synthetic pings + ingress logs).

— Karthik
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: downtime-window.csv (CSV), cred_calc.xlsx (Excel workbook with both tier and proportional calcs)
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, billing@auracorp.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, Jason Lee <jason.lee@auracorp.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed credit and escrow release — Auracorp (May incident)

Laura / Billing team — per Karthik's calc, Auracorp's actual uptime for May is 99.5963% (180m downtime). Under section 4.2 of the agreement the incident maps to the <99.90% SLA tier, which we interpret as a 20% credit on the May monthly invoice. Using the $120,000 run rate, proposed credit = $24,000.

There is an escrow bucket tied to the account (Account escrow id: HBSP-5729) with a current balance of $30,000 earmarked for monthly credits/adjustments. Requesting Finance to approve: (A) release $24,000 from escrow to apply as a credit memo CR-2027-0583, and (B) post the credit to Auracorp's account before the June 10 invoice cycle.

Next steps / asks:
- Laura: please confirm approval or request alternative routing (credit memo vs invoice adjustment).
- Billing: if approved, please create credit memo CR-2027-0583 and confirm posting date.
- Evelyn: I'll coordinate the customer-facing note once finance confirms.

I've attached the incident report for completeness (sla-incident-report.pdf).

— Markus
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai

3) Evelyn: please send the customer-facing confirmation and the final incident summary once the credit posts.
